slices.focus: Stairwell encounter with rescue dog clarifies Jae-hyun's pet vision.
slices.summary: On a sticky humid afternoon, Jae-hyun stops on his building's stair landing to watch a neighbor's mixed-breed rescue dog. The encounter sharpens his vague 'small dog someday' wish into a specific vision: a small older rescue, not a puppy, one that already has a calm temperament and can fit a quiet apartment routine. He and Min-seo share the image as a future goal without rushing into it.
open_loops: Researching older rescue temperament and care
Ensuring schedule can accommodate a pet
